exposure: timing of labor induction after PROM (spontaneous onset, induction < 12h, induction < 24h, induction > 24h)
cohort: 3174 women with PROM after 37 weeks of gestation admitted to the delivery room of LMU Women's Hospital between October 2015 and September 2020.
finding: Waiting for spontaneous contractions within the first 24 hours after PROM was not associated with increased maternal infection risk if no initial signs were present, but the risk increased beyond 24 hours, while newborn CRP levels were higher in induction groups <12h and >24h.
